description.value: Oregano's Pizza is a local Victoria pizzeria on Shelbourne Street specializing in made-to-order pies with over 20 signature specials plus a build-your-own option. The shop accommodates a range of dietary needs with gluten-free crust, lactose-free mozzarella, and vegan Daiya cheese. Pickup and delivery are both available, making it a solid calorie-refueling stop for touring cyclists passing through the Shelbourne corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 27m; stands (4 spaces) at 79m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Oregano's Pizza is an active pizza takeout and delivery shop at the Shelbourne Street location, matching the OSM phone (250.590.8884) and URL. The website explicitly lists gluten-free crust, lactose-free mozzarella, and vegan Daiya cheese, and repeatedly references pickup and delivery ordering. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging information appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website cart page reveals a second location (Fairfield, 250.590.2223) not reflected in this OSM record — a separate OSM node may exist for the Fairfield shop and should be checked to avoid duplicate or missing listings.
OSM tags include cryptocurrency payment tags (lightning, onchain, coinos) which are unusual; not relevant to WWC criteria but worth noting for data quality.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Oregano's is a legitimate, active food stop well-suited for calorie-hungry touring cyclists, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence and would need on-site or staff verification before listing.
